Subject: Remittance advice — wire transfer confirmation

Dear Finance Team,

This notice confirms payment pursuant to contract amendment CA-2026-09. The attached invoice reflects the compliance review fee for Q3 delivery milestones.

Regards,
Taylor Brooks
Accounts Receivable
NOTICE: Delivery schedule revision for enterprise proposal EP-4412. Purchase order authorization is required before shipment. Contact compliance if invoice totals differ from the signed contract.

Subject: Meeting schedule — vendor onboarding

Dear Procurement,

Please find the attached compliance checklist for the supplier contract. Payment terms remain net-30 pursuant to our master agreement.

Sincerely,
Morgan Ellis

Subject: Invoice dispute — duplicate billing

Dear Accounts Payable,

We received two invoices for the same delivery milestone. Please confirm which purchase order line item is authoritative before remittance.

Regards,
Casey Nguyen

snippet: NOTICE: Contract renewal requires compliance attestation and updated payment authorization. Attached proposal outlines delivery schedule changes effective next quarter.
